record.headline: Telnyx raised carrier fees on three carriers to $0.005 per message part and added fees for three more carriers.
rows: Thumb Cellular, United Wireless, Voxtelesys, per message part
record.who: Senders whose messages go to these regional carriers; the page does not say whether existing customers are affected.
record.read: Carrier surcharges are passed through to customers, so these changes likely follow carrier tariff updates rather than a Telnyx list-price move. The effect is small per message but applies on top of base rates.
record.caveat: Fee table is shown for outbound messages; the added carriers show N/A in the second column.

record.short: HGX B200 on-demand goes from $8.19 to $9.29 and HGX B300 from $9.99 to $11.49 per GPU hour.
record.headline: Together AI raised GPU cluster prices for NVIDIA HGX B200 and B300 on both on-demand and preemptible rates.

record.who: Customers renting B200 and B300 GPU clusters at published rates.
record.read: Blackwell capacity is tight and Together is repricing it upward rather than holding rates. Publishing prices for H200, B300 and GB300 that were previously contact-us suggests more list-price transparency alongside the increase.
record.caveat: Column labels inferred from the page table; the reserved column for B200 and B300 also changed, and the top GPU table now shows HGX B200 at $9.29 (was $8.99).
